verdict.rationale: Spline is a cloud-hosted design tool with built-in AI features (AI Agent, AI textures, AI 3D generation), so a training opt-out is a fair question for it. The evidence pack contains no documentation of any setting, policy or contractual control that keeps user data out of AI model training. Self-hosted export and cloud file storage are unrelated features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
